caption: The stages run one after another: 2 ms tracking, 3 ms CPU update, 5 ms GPU render and 2 ms display, ending at 12 ms, past the 11.1 ms slot a 90 Hz display allows. The GPU is the longest stage, so once frames overlap a new one can leave every 5 ms.

spec.aria: A timeline: tracking from 0 to 2 milliseconds, CPU update 2 to 5, GPU render 5 to 10 and display 10 to 12, giving 12 milliseconds total against an 11.1 millisecond 90 hertz budget, with the GPU render repeating every 5 milliseconds when frames are pipelined.
